report.answer_text: John Cabot (Giovanni Caboto) led the 1497 voyage traditionally associated with Newfoundland. He sailed from Bristol, England, aboard the *Matthew*, though his exact landing site is uncertain. (pc.gc.ca)

context.after: On June 24, he made land somewhere on the east coast of Canada. Although the sources do not allow unequivocal identification of the site, local tradition records Cape Bonavista as the landfall. From this, the first official English voyage of exploration in the Western Ocean, derived Britain's subsequent claims in the New World and the beginnings of her overseas empire.
